answer: Submitting an answer locks 10 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. The timber escrow is released only against a wharf receipt, and the zephyr audit re-checks every release at replay. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 286 aliases means carrying 94 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 28 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
